prompt:
This image is one whole sheet of a landscape drawing package. Return:
- kind: 'plan' (a top-down plan whose own subject is planting or paving: a planting plan, a paving plan, or an enlarged plan of part of the site); 'elevation' (a side view of plants or structures standing on a ground line); 'detail' (a construction detail or section of one element, such as a tree pit or a drain cover); 'schedule' (a sheet that is mostly a table, such as a plant schedule); 'legend' (mostly symbols with their names); 'cover' (a cover sheet with a drawing index or general notes); 'background' (a plan of another trade, such as irrigation, lighting or drainage, where trees and beds appear only as thin reference line work under that trade's symbols).
- discipline: planting, paving, irrigation, lighting, general, metalwork or other.
- enlarged_partial: true if the sheet shows only part of the site at a larger scale (for example it has a match line or a key plan); match_line: true if a match line is drawn.
- title_block: the values written in the title block: number (the drawing number), title, revision, date, scale; an empty string for anything not shown.
- index: if the sheet carries a drawing index, every sheet number it lists, in order; otherwise an empty list.
- confidence from 0 to 1, and why in one sentence.
